author: JerryRigEverything
description:
Today Cambry gets to drive her very own Lucid Gravity for the FIRST TIME out on the Salt Flats of UTAH.  The Bonneville Salt Flats is an ancient evaporated lake bed - and its where land speed records are broken. Will Cambry try and break a land speed record of her own in a Lucid Gravity?! Maybe... 

https://www.lucidmotors.com/gravity

Cambry knew she wanted the Lucid Gravity from her very first ride - and now she has one of her own!
title: HER DREAM CAME TRUE
